The '''Sy Myrthian Insurrection''' was fought in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], during the Imperial [[Reconquest of the Rim]], when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] attempted to drive out the [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|holdout]] forces of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] led by [[Sy Myrthian/Legends|Sy Myrthian]] ex-[[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Toonbuck Toora/Legends|Toonbuck Toora]] from the region around the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sy Myrth/Legends|Sy Myrth]]. The Confederacy had been [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|defeated]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the Empire's predecessor, previously that [[Standard year/Legends|year]] at the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During the campaign, the Imperial [[Twelfth Army/Legends|Twelfth Army]], under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Adar Tallon/Legends|Adar Tallon]] and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]], won battles at [[Diado]] and [[Metalorn/Legends|Metalorn]], and [[Siege of Sy Myrth|besieged]] Sy Myrth itself, before [[Battle of Trasemene|defeating]] the Separatist holdout forces under Toora in the [[Trasemene system/Legends|Trasemene system]], a battle in which Toora [[Gender/Legends|herself]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]], ending the insurrection.

==Prelude==
The [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] conflict known as the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] ended during [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|vanquishing]] the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. However, some Confederates continued to fight on as the [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdouts]] at the beginning of the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], including<ref name="Warfare" /> one of the Confederacy's founders,<ref name="HNN45">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|45|news/13228_1.html|Ando, Sy Myrth Secede}}</ref> [[Sy Myrthian/Legends|Sy Myrthian]] ex-[[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Toonbuck Toora/Legends|Toonbuck Toora]].

Toora managed to reactivate Separatist [[Army/Legends|ground]] and [[Navy/Legends|naval]] forces, as well as restart production in Confederate [[Factory world/Legends|factory worlds]] in the vicinity of her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Sy Myrth/Legends|Sy Myrth]], a stretch of space around the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] known as the "[[Foundry of the Confederacy/Legends|Foundry of the Confederacy]]." Uprisings like Toora's forced the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the successor of the Republic, to begin a large campaign known as the [[Reconquest of the Rim]]. The Imperials relocated the [[Twelfth Army/Legends|Twelfth Army]] to the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Charros IV/Legends|Charros IV]] in response to Toora's uprising.<ref name="Warfare" />

==The insurrection==
After several [[Standard month/Legends|months]] of fighting during 19 BBY, in which they reduced Toora's forces in an attritional campaign, the 12th Sector Army under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Adar Tallon/Legends|Adar Tallon]] and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]] emerged [[Battle of Diado|victorious]] at the world of [[Diado]]. It subsequently won another [[Battle of Metalorn (Imperial Period)|victory]] at [[Metalorn/Legends|Metalorn]].

Following those victories, the Imperials [[Siege of Sy Myrth|besieged]] Sy Myrth itself under Dodonna's expert guidance, eventually defeating the forces there. Tallon and Dodonna then chased down Toora's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], ''[[Defiance's Banner]]'', with a task force led by the [[Praetor-class Star Battlecruiser/Legends|''Praetor''-class Star Battlecruiser]] [[Battalion (Praetor-class)|''Battalion'']]. The end of the campaign [[Battle of Trasemene|came]] in the [[Trasemene system/Legends|Trasemene system]], after the Imperial task force cornered Toora's [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] there. In the ensuing battle, the ''Battalion'' ripped apart Toora's fleet with its [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser batteries]], [[Death/Legends|killing]] Toora and ending the insurrection.<ref name="Warfare" />

==Aftermath==
Though the Sy Myrthian Insurrection had ended, some Confederate followers continued to harass the Empire from the [[Kreetan Narrows]] region in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], close to Sy Myrth. As a result of the activities in the Kreetan Narrows, the Empire later [[Annexation of the northern Hutt territories|annexed]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]' northern territories, which included the Narrows and the worlds of [[Vaathkree/Legends|Vaathkree]], [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]], and [[Honoghr/Legends|Honoghr]].

Dodonna later received honors for his role in the pursuit and elimination of Toora, while his and Tallon's exploits were celebrated on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. Both men later became disillusioned with the Empire, however, after it became increasingly brutal and oppressive in its conduct, and after the [[Declaration of Rebellion/Legends|Declaration of Rebellion]] in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], Dodonna and Tallon would defect to the newly-formed [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="Warfare" />

==Behind the scenes==
The insurrection was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', an extensive [[Star Wars: Essential Guides|guide]] dedicated to the conflicts in the galaxy, written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]], and released in [[2012]].<ref name="Warfare" />
